hypotheses.G0_rank16_gradient_transfer: A rank-16 basis learned from 32 disjoint discovery gradients reaches at least 0.70 median cosine on held-out suffix gradients.
hypotheses.G1_rank32_gradient_transfer: The full discovery span reaches at least 0.85 median held-out gradient cosine.
hypotheses.G2_rank32_contribution_transfer: After multiplication by the held-out activation delta, rank-32 projected contributions have at least 0.70 median cosine with exact contribution vectors.
hypotheses.G3_rank32_support_transfer: Projected and exact top-64 positive supports have median Jaccard at least 0.20.
hypotheses.G4_rank32_preserves_first_order_leverage: Channels selected with the rank-32 gradient retain at least 70% of the exact top-64 positive first-order semantic shift in the median.
hypotheses.G5_subspace_beats_feature_mean: Rank-32 projected gradients exceed feature-mean gradients by at least 0.10 median cosine.
